description: 2024 Drivable street network around Joao Pessoa with Ponte do Futuro intervention project is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Lucy Donegan (Universidade Federal da Paraíba). This file was captured from OSM (Open Street Map) and then prepared and adjusted to add an intervention, in the following way, The OSM drivable network with a 46 km network distance catchment from João Pessoa was downloaded via OSMnx (in 2024), then this edge file was converted into planar CRS (EPSG:31985 - SIRGAS 2000/ ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
